subject: Cron_Timezone_Logic

verified_options.name: resolveCronTimezone
verified_options.description: Returns timezone string: explicit tz if provided, otherwise system timezone via Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone

verified_options.name: CRON_EVAL_CACHE_MAX / cronEvalCache
verified_options.description: LRU cache for compiled Cron instances keyed by `${timezone}�${expr}`; max size 512

verified_options.name: resolveCachedCron
verified_options.description: Compile or return cached `Cron` instance (uses `new Cron(expr, { timezone, catch: false })`)

verified_options.name: resolveCronFromSchedule
verified_options.description: Extracts cron expression from schedule and resolves timezone via `resolveCronTimezone`

verified_options.name: computeNextRunAtMs
verified_options.description: Core next-run computation: supports `at`, `every`, and `cron`; for `cron` uses croner.nextRun(Date) and includes retry workarounds for croner year-rollback (e.g. Asia/Shanghai)

verified_options.name: parseAbsoluteTimeMs
verified_options.description: Normalizes ISO inputs: appends 'Z' for date-only or datetime-without-tz; accepts numeric epoch strings; returns ms or null

verified_options.name: validateScheduleTimestamp
verified_options.description: Validates `at` timestamps disallowing >1 minute past and >10 years future

verified_options.name: resolveStableCronOffsetMs / computeStaggeredCronNextRunAtMs
verified_options.description: Per-job stable stagger offset (sha256(jobId) mod staggerMs) used to shift cron cursor so jobs can be staggered within a window

verified_options.name: shouldRepairFutureCronNextRunAtMs
verified_options.description: Heuristic to detect and repair stale/incorrect future nextRunAtMs values (avoids silent schedule drift)

logic_flow: If cron: computeStaggeredCronNextRunAtMs → computeNextRunAtMs (cron branch) → resolveCronFromSchedule → resolveCachedCron → new Cron(expr,{timezone}) → cron.nextRun(new Date(now))
Maintenance path: recomputeNextRunsForMaintenance avoids advancing existing future nextRunAtMs unless repair conditions are met

test_evidence.behavior: cron schedule using explicit tz (Asia/Shanghai) and computeNextRunAtMs behavior is exercised
daily cron skip regression references recomputeNextRunsForMaintenance semantics
